lines.zh: 我八条腿踩着枯草往前走。
lines.en: Eight legs carry me over the dead grass.
I move fast, legs never resting.

lines.zh: 我的身子是湿的，走过留痕。
lines.en: My body is wet and leaves a trail.
I crawl low to the ground.
I circle that heap of bones.

lines.zh: 我一节一节地挪动身子。
lines.en: I shift my body one segment at a time.
I head for the smell of blood.

lines.zh: 我在枯草上跑，草一片片断。
lines.en: I run through the grass and it snaps.
I climb a rise and look down.
I follow the few ahead of me.
I pass quickly by your feet.

lines.zh: 我的腿尖在地上点出小坑。
lines.en: My leg tips dot the ground.
I crawl along the ditch edge.
I stop and start, in rhythm.
I turn and come around the side.

lines.zh: 我爬过一段碎石，没有声音。
lines.en: I cross gravel without a sound.
My shadow on the grass is small.
I stop, a few legs still shifting.
I'm licking one of my legs.
My body swells and slackens.
There's nothing to eat here.
I lift my forelegs a little.
I wait for the others to move first.

lines.zh: 我的几只眼睛各自看一边。
lines.en: My eyes look different ways.

lines.zh: 枯草的影子在我身上动。
lines.en: The dead grass shifts its shadow on me.
I spit a little silk on the ground.

lines.zh: 我听见了很远的脚步声。
lines.en: I hear footsteps far off.
I raise my head and several eyes find you.
I crawl toward your feet.
One step and I'm gone.
I smell a wound on you.
You shouldn't stand in the dead grass.
My teeth are small, and many.
You're looking at me. I'm smelling you.

lines.zh: 别转头，我盯着你的血肉。
lines.en: Don't turn away. I'm watching your flesh.
I roll over, legs flailing.

lines.zh: 这一下压断了我一条腿。
lines.en: That breaks one of my legs.
My fluid drips onto the grass.
I hiss, short and sharp.
I retreat under a stone.

lines.zh: 我的腿还在动，身子不动。
lines.en: My legs keep moving; my body doesn't.
I'm climbing again.
Two holes have opened in me.
Leaking fluid, I'm still hungry.
I've caught that smell.
I crawl toward your hand.
I look up and wait, patient.
This isn't enough to share.
I reach with a leg.
Drop it and I'll pounce.
As I eat, others come.
This blood isn't fresh.
I want more than this.

lines.zh: 你碰了我一下，我翻过去。
lines.en: You touch me and I flip over.

lines.zh: 我八条腿乱抓，翻回来了。
lines.en: Eight legs scrabble and I right myself.
I'm knocked back a short way.
I duck into the grass.

lines.zh: 这一下压断了我两条腿。
lines.en: The impact breaks two of my legs.
I slide along the edge of your boot.
I'm up again quickly.
I go around you, very close.
My silk sticks to your foot.
I don't retreat; I circle around.

lines.zh: 这一下把草压平了一片。
lines.en: The impact flattens a swath of grass.
Several of us crowd together.
Her legs are a little longer than mine.
We hold still on the dead grass.
She lowers her head to touch me.
We make no sound.
We divide this patch.
She goes first; I follow.
We gather around the same heap of bones.
Her body is redder than mine.
At night we scatter.
I hold it with two legs.
I wrap it in a little silk.
I drag it back.
It falls in the grass and I lose it.
I hook it on a leg.
It's a bit heavier than I am.
I lift it and put it down.
I eat as I go.

lines.zh: 这东西我留给后面几只。
lines.en: I'll leave it for the others.
I saw something move.
I turn and all my legs brace.
Something warm and alive is here.
Several of us saw it at once.
I press my body to the ground.
My mouthparts keep working.
That isn't a stone.
My eight legs start moving faster.

lines.zh: 它跑不掉的，我就在旁边。
lines.en: It won't get away; I'm right beside it.
I have the spot it stands on.
Of the group, I move first.
I follow through the grass, fast.

lines.zh: 它的脚踩断枯草，声音很大。
lines.en: It snaps dead grass and it's loud.

lines.zh: 八条腿贴着草根挪过去。
lines.en: Eight legs slide along the grass roots.
The others are closing in too.
I'm right at its heel.
It turns and I slip underneath.
I crawl into its shadow.
Its footsteps are getting ragged.
I'm very close.
I lift my forelegs above my back.
Now it's my turn to leap up.
I bite into the ankle.
I sink my teeth and hold.
The others are on it too.

lines.zh: 它甩腿，我掉下去又爬上来。
lines.en: It shakes its leg; I fall and climb back.

lines.zh: 我用丝把它的一只脚缠住。
lines.en: I bind one of its feet with silk.
Its blood is warm.
I bite and pull back.

lines.zh: 它踩死了我旁边的一只。
lines.en: It crushes the one beside me.
I lunge up at it once more.
I crawl out of the dead grass.
There's a lot of movement in the soil.
I didn't come alone.
Several of us come up together.

lines.zh: 湿土从我的腹下滴下去。
lines.en: Wet soil drips from under my abdomen.
The smell here is strong.

lines.zh: 我的八只眼各看一个方向。
lines.en: My eight eyes each watch a different direction.
All my legs are steady.
I start hunting for blood.
More are coming behind me.

lines.zh: 火燎到我，我在地上打滚。
lines.en: Fire catches me and I roll on the ground.
I fall and several legs break.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，我抓不住岸。
lines.en: Water holds me down and I can't grip the bank.

lines.zh: 冲击把我身上的丝都吹散了。
lines.en: The blast blows the silk off me.
A pin sticks me to the ground.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的腿都僵了。
lines.en: The light freezes all my legs.

lines.zh: 饿得没有力气，我爬不动了。
lines.en: Too starved to move, I stop crawling.

lines.zh: 雷顺着我的腿走了一遍。
lines.en: Lightning runs down my legs.
No grass below, no ground either.
